name: G1
summary:
Unitree G1 is a compact humanoid platform for motion research, interaction and embodied-intelligence development. Its large joint ranges support flexible whole-body poses, while the platform's software uses imitation and reinforcement learning to develop movement skills.

Unitree offers configurations with different joint counts, computing equipment and hand options. Optional force-controlled dexterous hands combine position and force feedback for manipulation experiments. The development ecosystem supports work on perception and learned policies, with updates continuing over time. G1 specific

description.en:
Unitree G1 is a compact humanoid platform for motion research, interaction and embodied-intelligence development. Its large joint ranges support flexible whole-body poses, while the platform's software uses imitation and reinforcement learning to develop movement skills.

Unitree offers configurations with different joint counts, computing equipment and hand options. Optional force-controlled dexterous hands combine position and force feedback for manipulation experiments. The development ecosystem supports work on perception and learned policies, with updates continuing over time. G1 specifications and developer access vary between editions, so a base model should not be assumed to include the hardware or interfaces of an education configuration.

specs.label: Payload per arm
specs.conditions: G1 standard model; approximately 2 kg maximum arm load.

specs.label: Total degrees of freedom
specs.conditions: G1 standard model; EDU optional configurations range up to 43.

specs.label: Weight
specs.conditions: G1 standard model, approximately 35 kg including battery; EDU configuration varies.
